title: Vault Breach
use: Cold open: full volume from the first beat. Roller 1 «THE BREAK» and any cut that starts on an impact.
prompt: Dark cinematic heist trailer music, 120 BPM, instrumental, no vocals. No intro: a massive sub-bass impact hits on the very first beat. Metallic percussion that sounds like a heavy vault lock clicking, tight ticking hi-hats like a countdown, pulsing low synth bass, rising tension with a riser, a hard stop and half a second of silence around the 8 second mark, then a huge triumphant drop with deep drums and a short three-note brass motif. Modern, premium, punchy, clean wide mix, ends on a single resonant hit.
